about: Queue for the Free Spine (Back & Spine) mannequin clips, generated in the Gemini web app the same way as the Open Hips clips (Create video, Portrait, text only, one new chat per clip). DRAFT: the program in content/programs/back.ts and these pose descriptions were written by Claude from general coaching knowledge; Felipe has not checked them yet.
template: A smooth beige 3D anatomy mannequin, male, faceless with no eyes and no mouth, visible ball joints at shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees and ankles, athletic build, wearing only black shorts, white crew socks and white sneakers. Dark gym, black rubber floor, neon green rim light from the right, nobody else in the room. {view}, static camera that never moves, entire body in frame, no tripod or camera equipment anywhere in the room. He starts already in this position: {start} He does only one movement: {motion} Exactly 3 slow repetitions, then he holds still in the starting position. He never changes position and never does any other movement. Working muscles: {glow}. They light up as glowing neon green anatomical muscle fibers drawn as a graphic overlay on top of the body and on top of the black shorts, so wherever a working muscle is under the shorts its glow shows on the shorts too, with visible fiber strands in the real shape of each muscle, brightest while the muscle works and dimmer when it rests. No red or skinless muscle anywhere: outside the green glow the body stays smooth plain beige. No cuts, no text. Portrait 9:16.
run_rules: Same run rules as assets/glossary/hips-queue.json (read its run_rules). Clips for this program go to public/programs/back/clips/<exercise-slug>.mp4 and are listed in content/programs/program-clips.ts under "back".

clips.name: Cat Cow
clips.start: on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back flat.
clips.motion: keeping the hands and knees planted, he slowly rounds his whole back up toward the ceiling with the head dropping, then slowly arches the back down with the chest and head lifting. He never moves his hands or knees and never sits back.
clips.glow: only the long muscles running along both sides of the spine, from the base of the neck all the way down to the top of the shorts, and the abs on the front of the belly. No glow on the arms or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Superman Lifts
clips.start: lying face down, legs straight and together, arms straight overhead on the floor, forehead resting on the floor.
clips.motion: he lifts both arms, the chest and both legs a few centimetres off the floor at the same time, pauses, then lowers everything back down. He never rocks and never lifts one side at a time.
clips.glow: only the long muscles along both sides of the spine, from between the shoulder blades all the way down to the top of the shorts, and both glutes under the shorts, glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the arms or the front of the body. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Child's Pose
clips.start: kneeling with the big toes touching and the knees apart, hips sitting back on the heels, torso folded forward between the thighs, forehead on the floor, both arms stretched straight forward on the floor.
clips.motion: keeping the hands planted far forward and the hips on the heels, he takes a deep breath so his back rounds and widens, pauses, then sinks the chest a little deeper as he breathes out. He never lifts up out of the pose.
clips.glow: only the long muscles along both sides of the lower spine, from the middle of the back down to the top of the shorts, and the lats on both sides of the back. No glow on the arms or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Cobra Stretch
clips.start: lying face down, legs straight, tops of the feet on the floor, hands flat under the shoulders, elbows bent and tucked against the ribs.
clips.motion: keeping the hips and legs on the floor, he slowly straightens the arms halfway, lifting the chest into a gentle backbend with the shoulders down away from the ears, pauses, then lowers the chest back to the floor. The hips never lift.
clips.glow: only the abs, the long flat muscles on the front of the belly from the bottom of the ribs all the way down under the waistband of the shorts, with the bottom part glowing on the black shorts, and the long muscles along both sides of the lower spine. No glow on the arms or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Standing Side Bend
clips.start: standing tall, feet hip width apart, both arms straight overhead with the fingers interlaced and the palms facing the ceiling.
clips.motion: keeping the hips still and the arms overhead, he leans his torso over to the left side, pauses, then comes back up to standing tall. He only ever leans to the left and never leans to the right or forward.
clips.glow: only the right side of the body: the right lat and the right obliques, from the right armpit down the right side of the ribs to the right hip. No glow on the left side or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Glute Bridge
clips.start: lying on his back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip width apart and close to the glutes, arms flat by his sides with the palms down.
clips.motion: pushing through the heels, he lifts his hips until the body makes a straight line from the knees to the shoulders, squeezes, pauses, then lowers the hips back to the floor. The feet and arms stay planted.
clips.glow: only both glutes, the big muscles on the back of the hips under the shorts, glowing brightly on the black shorts, and the long muscles along both sides of the lower spine. No glow on the front of the thighs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Knee Hug
clips.start: lying on his back, both knees pulled in to the chest, arms wrapped around the shins, head resting on the floor.
clips.motion: keeping his head and lower back on the floor, he hugs both knees closer to his chest, pauses, then lets them drift a little away with the arms still around the shins. He never rocks or rolls.
clips.glow: only the long muscles along both sides of the lower spine, from the middle of the back down to the top of the shorts, and both glutes under the shorts, glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the arms or the front of the body. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Supine Twist
clips.start: lying on his back, arms straight out to the sides on the floor with the palms down, both knees bent and pulled up over the hips with the feet off the floor.
clips.motion: keeping both shoulders and arms flat on the floor, he lowers both knees together to the right side until they rest on the floor, pauses, then lifts them back up over the hips. He only drops the knees to the right and never to the left.
clips.glow: only the left obliques on the left side of the waist, from the bottom of the ribs to the left hip, and the left side of the lower back. No glow on the arms, legs or right side. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Open Book
clips.start: lying on his left side, hips and knees bent at 90 degrees with the knees stacked together, both arms straight out in front of the chest at shoulder height with the palms together, head resting on the floor.
clips.motion: keeping both knees stacked together on the floor, he lifts the right arm and opens it up and over to the right like a page of a book, rotating his chest until the right hand reaches toward the floor behind him, eyes following the hand, pauses, then brings the right arm back on top of the left. Only the right arm and chest move and he never rolls onto his back or switches sides.
clips.glow: only the right chest muscle from the breastbone to the right shoulder, and the muscles along the spine between the shoulder blades. No glow on the legs or the left side. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation
clips.start: on all fours, left hand under the left shoulder, knees under the hips, right hand behind the head with the right elbow pointing down at the floor.
clips.motion: keeping the left hand planted and the hips still, he rotates the chest up and open so the right elbow points at the ceiling, eyes following the elbow, pauses, then rotates back down so the right elbow points toward the left wrist. He only moves the right side and never switches hands.
clips.glow: only the muscles between the shoulder blades along the upper spine, and the right side of the upper back. No glow on the arms, legs or left side. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Jefferson Curl
clips.start: standing tall on top of a low box, feet hip width apart, legs straight, arms hanging by his sides, chin tucked to the chest.
clips.motion: keeping the legs straight, he slowly rolls down one vertebra at a time, head first, until his fingers reach below the edge of the box past his toes, pauses, then slowly rolls back up to standing, head last. He never bends the knees much and never steps off the box.
clips.glow: only the long muscles running along both sides of the spine, from the base of the neck all the way down to the top of the shorts, and both hamstrings on the back of the thighs, from behind the knees all the way up under the shorts, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the arms or the front of the body. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Camel Pose
clips.start: kneeling upright with the knees hip width apart, thighs vertical, toes tucked under, hands on the lower back with the fingers pointing down.
clips.motion: keeping the hips pushed forward over the knees, he lifts the chest and leans back into a backbend, reaching both hands down to rest on the heels, pauses, then brings the hands back to the lower back and comes upright. The thighs stay vertical.
clips.glow: only the abs, the long flat muscles on the front of the belly from the bottom of the ribs all the way down under the waistband of the shorts, with the bottom part glowing on the black shorts, and the front of both hips. No glow on the arms or the back. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red
